{{#forminput:form=Property|button text=add Property}}
=== Documentation ===
A trip is the root of a journey: it has a start and a destination, a time span and an ordered list of [[Concept:Leg|legs]] between [[Concept:Loc|locations]]. Legs and locations are stored as subobjects on the trip page.
